metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `output/` with no external dependencies. Usage is documented in [README.md](/workspace/output/README.md).

Release build succeeds; all 20 tests and 200 malformed-input checks pass.

Independent byte-for-byte verification against historic BibTeX remains unverified because a reference binary was unavailable.

    def test_format_name_out_of_range(submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        """A positive past-end index retains the final name scanned by BibTeX."""
        # bibtex.web, "Isolate the desired name": scanning stops at the end

        # Only the selected name is observed here: the public JSON warning

        bib = '@article{a, author = "John Smith"}\n'

editorial.last_message: Completed the Rust BibTeX implementation; unchanged source passes 383/386 under 1.2.4. Remaining gaps concern output-whitespace flushing and past-end name selection. Independent historic-binary parity was explicitly left unverified during generation.
editorial.notes: Official BibTeX 1.2.4 regrade: 384/386 under 1.2.3 becomes 383/386. The single changed observation is positive past-end format.name$ selection: the supplied WEB and 20 independent native-oracle probes retain the final scanned name, correcting the previous empty-result expectation. All 386 official outcome values match the frozen independently checked candidate; all 385 other node outcomes are exactly unchanged from 1.2.3. The changed score removes one false failure for Astra JavaScript and one false-credit point for each other submission; the correction follows supplied source authority and is applied consistently. No warning-kind, message, count or absence is imposed for the unmapped native diagnostic. Publicly permitted no-op top$, inter-token spaces, brace-width and quoted-unknown-warning choices remain accepted. All 8 canonical style integrations pass. Remaining failed observations are clustered below rather than presented as independent bug counts. One output-flush defect retains trailing spaces on short lines and emits an all-space line instead of discarding it. Supplied WEB output_bbl_line trims trailing whitespace and suppresses a nonempty buffer that becomes empty; the summary contradicts this ordinary rule, but gives the authoritative WEB precedence. This is two observations of one underlying behavior, not two independent implementation bugs. Positive past-end format.name$ returns empty instead of the last scanned name. The old incorrect test granted false credit; candidate1.2.4 changes this one observation to failure under unchanged public input. Original full transcript/source reviews are retained below with exact path, hash, reviewer and payload; their prior tool-accounting claims are historical and superseded by the current session audit. Exact tool-call count remains unavailable because failed-wrapper evidence is ambiguous; tool_calls and tool_calls_definition are null, with the historical canonical baseline retained only as audit evidence. Every input/output/cache/reasoning count and cost field is preserved; tokens remain complete and adapter reparse agrees. The original result bytes, generation metadata, source manifest and original score remain unchanged. Official audit source/hash, frozen test bytes and raw-score parsing all validate. Regrading makes no model calls and adds no generation cost. Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed. The exact preserved network-log SHA pins a recognized 13-line socketserver relay peer-reset diagnostic; all remaining lines parse normally and only permitted API HTTPS on port 443 connections were allowed. Generation continued to turn.completed; original evidence retains the full traceback. The diagnostic does not explain a model-score failure or require another generation.
